items.headline: Allen, Jackson, Burrow lead MVP faves; non-QBs lead OROY odds
items.description: Quarterbacks Josh Allen, Lamar Jackson and Joe Burrow lead an early list of NFL MVP favorites, while RB Jeremiyah Love and WR Carnell Tate top Offensive Rookie of the Year odds.

items.headline: Ravens QB Jackson: Success this season means 'us winning it all'
items.description: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson said Tuesday that "winning it all" would constitute a successful season in his eyes.

items.headline: Jovaughn Gwyn named Ravens' starting center for Week 1
items.description: Jamison Hensley reports on the Ravens naming Jovaughn Gwyn their starting center for Week 1 over the more experienced Ethan Pocic.

items.headline: Orioles offer free tix, say Ravens WR not at fault for promo
items.description: The Orioles are offering complimentary tickets to fans in their "Bird Bath" section after the team promoted Ravens wide receiver Zay Flowers as a guest splasher, then changed plans.

items.headline: Ravens name Gwyn to start at center to begin post-Linderbaum era
items.description: Ravens coach Jesse Minter announced Jovaughn Gwyn will be Baltimore's starting center for the season opener at the Colts.

items.headline: Four biggest questions facing Lamar Jackson and Ravens
items.description: Despite heightened expectations of success, the Ravens have a handful of questions to answer.
